network_and_host_entrypoint_contract.selected_design: Run-owned unique Docker bridge and explicit host-installed deny rules, not an unverifiable assertion that unrestricted bridge cannot reach host credentials. No proxy platform is required. Ordinary public installer Internet egress remains allowed; capture uses a separate network-none container.
network_and_host_entrypoint_contract.setup: Derive bridge interface name <=15characters and unique owned chain/network identity from a fresh random run identity. Fail on preexisting/colliding identities. Create IPv6-disabled owned network. Before any candidate container starts, create the owned IPv4 deny chain and install exact first-position DOCKER-USER interface jump, host INPUT interface reject, and IPv6 INPUT and FORWARD interface rejects. Do not append these behind existing RETURN/ACCEPT rules. Read back all exact rules/identities and fail closed if any setup or verification fails.
network_and_host_entrypoint_contract.ipv4_policy: In the owned chain reject host/local/private/link-local/metadata and nonpublic special-use destinations, including loopback, RFC1918, CGNAT, link-local, multicast/reserved, documentation and benchmarking ranges; RETURN only after those rejects so ordinary public Docker egress policy continues. Reject every container-bridge INPUT packet to host. Post-DNAT destinations and routing must remain covered; no authenticated host service is explicitly exposed. Embedded Docker DNS stays namespace-local; resolution of a private address does not exempt subsequent traffic from deny rules. Retain interface-scoped IPv6 rejects even when Docker network IPv6 is disabled; no broad host sysctl changes.
network_and_host_entrypoint_contract.ownership_and_cleanup: Track exact original run-owned chain/network/rule/container identities outside every candidate mount. Candidate is nonroot and cap-dropALL and cannot modify firewall or Docker. Stop/remove all owned containers and verify absence before collecting and before removing any deny guard. Delete only exact recorded owned jumps/rules/chain/network; never flush unrelated state, accept unknown collisions, remove another run or release egress while an owned candidate remains. Cleanup/setup failures stay explicit failures with retained diagnostics and safe manual recovery facts.
network_and_host_entrypoint_contract.actual_verification: A separate isolated GitHub infrastructure probe is required before protected activation to prove actual image/UID/Git/.venv/tmp and firewall behavior on the intended runner. It must test successful public pip/network access, rejection of host/gateway/private/link-local/metadata destinations, IPv6 escape rejection and capture network-none.
